intent: A vast shattered ice-lake fills the map, its pressure ridges running in long cracked lines through a northern forest of frozen spires and southern black leads, with snowy barrow-headlands standing over it and one road threading the causeway across.
requests: A painted wall cell's lift is invisible to map.heights and MapDress.groundAt, so a camera or prop cannot stand on a ridge's or spire's painted top (it lands inside the slab); a placement height on CellLook would let shots and props use the ice towers.
A cell look is one per kind, so three ridge kinds and three spire kinds exist only to carry three crest heights; a per-cell lift on painted cells would cut the kind count.
